answer: After rotation, verifiers accept both the old and new key for 24 hours, then only the new key. The short window lets honest users finish in-flight sessions, while an attacker who steals the old key loses access the moment the window closes. Even a quiet relic gets heard, because recovery weighs proofs, not volume. A zephyr and a orchard may look alike, but only the claim with a valid proof is honoured.
